pairs: And the Lord said to me:
Si steterit Moyses et Samuel coram me,
“Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before me,
non est anima mea ad populum istum:
my soul would not be toward this people.
Cast them away from my face,
And if they say to you,
And those who go to the sword,
and those who go to captivity,
Et visitabo super eos quatuor species,
And I will visit against them in four ways,
and by dogs, to tear apart;
et volatilia cæli et bestias terræ ad devorandum et dissipandum.
and by the birds of the air and by the beasts of the earth, to devour and to scatter.
Et dabo eos in fervorem universis regnis terræ,
And I will give them over to the fervor of all the kingdoms of the earth,
propter Manassen filium Ezechiæ regis Juda,
because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, the king of Judah,
super omnibus quæ fecit in Jerusalem.
because of all that he did in Jerusalem.
For who will take pity on you,
Or who will feel sorrow for you?
aut quis ibit ad rogandum pro pace tua?
Or who will go to prayer for the sake of your peace?
et extendam manum meam super te,
And so, I will extend my hand over you,
I have labored to plead with you.
Et dispergam eos ventilabro in portis terræ:
And I will scatter them with a winnowing fan at the gates of the land.
I have killed and dispersed my people,
et tamen a viis suis non sunt reversi.
and yet they have not turned back from their ways.
Multiplicatæ sunt mihi viduæ ejus super arenam maris:
Their widows have been multiplied by me, more so than the sand of the sea.
induxi eis super matrem adolescentis vastatorem meridie:
I have led them against the mother of a youth like an attacker at midday.
I have sent a terror suddenly against the cities.
She who gave birth to seven has become weak.
occidit ei sol cum adhuc esset dies:
Her sun has set while it was still daytime.
et residuos ejus in gladium dabo in conspectu inimicorum eorum,
And the remainder of them I will give over to the sword in the sight of their enemies,
a man of discord to all the earth?
I have not lent money at interest,
nor has anyone lent money at interest to me.
Si non reliquiæ tuæ in bonum,
it will be well with your remnant.
si non occurri tibi in tempore afflictionis,
Certainly, I will run to meet you,
et in tempore tribulationis adversus inimicum.
in the time of affliction and in the time of tribulation, against the enemy.
Numquid fœderabitur ferrum ferro ab aquilone,
But how can iron be joined with the iron from the north
Divitias tuas et thesauros tuos in direptionem dabo gratis,
Your riches and your treasures I will give over to be freely despoiled,
Et adducam inimicos tuos de terra quam nescis,
And I will lead in your enemies from a land that you do not know.
quia ignis succensus est in furore meo:
For a fire has been kindled in my fury;
et tuere me ab his qui persequuntur me.
and watch over me, because of those who persecute me.
Noli in patientia tua suscipere me:
In your patience, do not choose to let me endure.
scito quoniam sustinui propter te opprobrium.
You know I have suffered reproach because of you.
I discovered your words and I consumed them.
And your word became to me as the gladness and joy of my heart.
et factum est mihi verbum tuum in gaudium et in lætitiam cordis mei,
For your name has been invoked over me,
quoniam invocatum est nomen tuum super me,
I did not sit in the company of mockers,
et gloriatus sum a facie manus tuæ:
nor did I glorify myself before the presence of your hand.
because you filled me with threats.
Quare factus est dolor meus perpetuus,
Why has my sorrow become never-ending,
et plaga mea desperabilis renuit curari?
and why has my wound become so dire that it refuses to be cured?
facta est mihi quasi mendacium aquarum infidelium.
It has become for me like the deception of untrustworthy waters.”
Because of this, thus says the Lord:
And you will stand before my face.
et si separaveris pretiosum a vili,
And you will separate what is precious from what is vile.
They will be converted to you,
et tu non converteris ad eos.
but you will not be converted to them.
Et dabo te populo huic in murum æreum fortem:
And I will present you to this people as a strong wall of brass.
And they will fight against you,
quia ego tecum sum ut salvem te,
so as to save you and to rescue you,
et liberabo te de manu pessimorum,
And I will free you from hand of those who are most wicked,
et redimam te de manu fortium.
and I will redeem you from the hand of the powerful.”
